mapper.select: select id, title, content, cover_image, is_top, status, create_time, update_time from chat_app.announcement where status = 1 order by is_top desc, create_time desc
select id, title, content, cover_image, is_top, status, create_time, update_time from chat_app.announcement where id = #{id} and status = 1

select id, title, content, cover_image, is_top, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from chat_app.announcement
and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by is_top desc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into chat_app.announcement (title, content, cover_image, is_top, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
